QuestInfo.0: #b#p9120003##k, a proud entrepreneur of #b#m801000000##k, seems very upset. You should go talk to her and see what's wrong.
QuestInfo.1: #p9120003# says #m800000000# has been getting creepier by the day, not to mention less profitable, ever since ghosts started stealing all the #t4000222#s in the area. She's desperate for help in chasing away #b100 #o9400011#s#k and retrieving the lanterns. Why don't you see what you can do?\r\n#o9400011# #r#a43061##k\r\n#t4000222# #b#c4000222#/50
QuestInfo.2: Not only did you get rid of all the #o9400011#s, but you made sure they'll stay away by returning all of the #t4000222#s to their proper places. Thanks to you, #m800000000# will be a much safer place now.

0.0: Young adventurer! Do you have a moment? I could really use the assistance of a good fighter like yourself. I promise I'll only take a moment your time.

yes.0: Great! We've had some frightful ghost problems lately. They keep stealing our #t4000222#s! If you could shoo away, say, #b100 #o9400011#s#k, it'd be a huge help. We also need about #b50 #t4000222#s#k to replace what the ghosts stole, so see if you can track some down while you're at it. I'd do it myself, but someone's got to stay here and run my business, you know?

no.0: No? That's too bad. Now I don't know where I'm going to get #t4000222#s.

1.0: If I don't see any more #o9400011#s for another 20 years, it'll be too soon. They were scaring away all my customers! Thank you for the help!

yes.0: Perfect! It was starting to get really creepy around here without the #t4000222#s to light our way. Thank you!
